quantization: symmetric full-row INT6 nearest-even; exact FP32 scales as rational integers; input activation scale is common positive and cancels in argmax
selection_scope: One complete original Qwen row and aligned slices of three other original rows. Host must compute the recorded complements and add them before row scaling and vocabulary selection.
input_order_scope: Chip wire order differs from model order. Host live_demo gathers using input_permutation; generic board client accepts wire-order activations.
